<!-- pr-reviewer: 66633a80c93f7e5ac32455346b09f9aade29875b -->
Needs changes before merge.

The desktop log keeps earlier records and writes each record to disk. The panic hook calls the previous hook. The tests cover file logging with terminal logging off, startup failures, panic records, and log-open failures.

I reviewed the laws in current upstream main, `983f527bd7aab4f856666e62f0c06f381bc57474`. The local trial merge had no conflicts. All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2459`. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 13 steps:

| Suite | Passed | Ignored | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| app lib | 364 | 1 | 0 |
| app logging | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| ui lib | 1098 | 7 | 0 |
| ui boundary | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| ui boundary_picks | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| ui sinker_setup | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| ui startup_log | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| ui tap_hand | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| ui theme_example | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| ui theme_files | 15 | 0 | 0 |
| ui waterjet_tool | 1 | 0 | 0 |

The first clippy command failed:

```text
cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings
error: the borrowed expression implements the required traits
   --> crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:128:18
128 |             .map(&resolve)
```

Current upstream main has the same expression. This PR does not change that file. The command passed when repeated with `-A clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args`. Thus, the unmodified clippy command is not green.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window.rs:310`: Add before and after screenshots of the changed startup error dialog to the PR body. Show the log location and backend retry instructions. The body currently has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body. Do not add them to the PR branch.

Notes:

- This PR does not change posted G-code, collision or gouge checks, stock simulation, or geometry. Safety-tier mutation checks do not apply. I did not run mutations.
- No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens changed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD` passed.
- The compile cache stalled during the first planner build. I stopped that command and completed the checks with the cache disabled.
- Windows dialogs, physical GPU failures, and survival of a full system lock were not tested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: Added the requested before and after startup error dialog screenshots to the PR body. The after image shows the log location and backend retry instructions.

The images live only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, at commit `7c4fb88d69041c75aff90027164c92d3ab709f6b`. The captures use native Linux rfd/zenity dialogs with the same synthetic no-adapter message. They do not test a physical GPU failure or Windows dialogs.

The external screenshot evidence check failed with the links removed (RED) and passed with them restored (GREEN). No committed test was needed for this evidence-only fix.

Head is unchanged: `66633a80c93f7e5ac32455346b09f9aade29875b`. Strict clippy passed. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 13 steps with a worktree-local target directory. The first run used stale main-checkout assets through the shared target directory and failed; the corrected run passed.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 66633a80c93f7e5ac32455346b09f9aade29875b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review replaces the earlier screenshot finding on the same head. The later `Addressed` comment permits this evidence review.

I opened both screenshots from the PR body. The after image shows the log location and the backend retry flags. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `7c4fb88d69041c75aff90027164c92d3ab709f6b`. They are not in the PR diff. The body explains the synthetic Linux capture and its limits. The earlier requested change is complete.

The desktop logger preserves earlier records. It records startup errors and panic backtraces. The panic hook calls the previous hook. The GPU records include adapter and driver details.

I used the current upstream laws at `983f527bd7aab4f856666e62f0c06f381bc57474`. The trial merge with that main had no conflicts. All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2459`, with its own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

Both selected test builds passed. I ran these suites through `cargo test`:

| Suite | Passed | Ignored | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| app lib | 364 | 1 | 0 |
| app logging | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| ui lib | 1098 | 7 | 0 |
| ui boundary | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| ui boundary_picks | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| ui sinker_setup | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| ui startup_log | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| ui tap_hand | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| ui theme_example | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| ui theme_files | 15 | 0 | 0 |
| ui waterjet_tool | 1 | 0 | 0 |

Strict clippy still fails on the upstream lint from the earlier review:

```text
cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings
error: the borrowed expression implements the required traits
   --> crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:128:18
128 |             .map(&resolve)
```

This file matches current upstream main. This PR does not change it. Clippy passed with only `-A clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args` added. Thus, the strict command is not green on this machine. This is an existing upstream problem, not a new blocker from this PR.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. Safety-tier mutation checks do not apply. I did not run mutations.
- No NC, CL, or snapshot goldens changed. `git diff --check upstream/main` passed.
- The gate dry run included unrelated main changes because the trial merge was uncommitted. I selected the touched suites directly. I did not run the full quick gate.
- Windows dialogs, physical GPU failures, and survival of a full system lock were not tested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
